whatIsIt.eli5: Keeps every layer of notes in a calm, steady range.
whatIsIt.simple: Batch normalization: for each channel, subtracts the average and divides by the spread seen in training, then applies a learned scale and shift.
whatIsIt.engineer: Per-channel affine standardisation with running mean/var; 2·C learnable params; folded into the conv at export.

whyExists.simple: Keeps values well-scaled so training is faster and more stable.
whyExists.engineer: Reduces internal covariate shift; allows higher learning rates.
